newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL spot tin price rebounds on foreign demand.
newsitem.headline: KL spot tin price rebounds on foreign demand.

text.p: Malaysia's spot tin price rebounded to finish 12 cents higher at 13.91 ringgit ($5.53) a kg with foreign demand emerging following a firmer London close.
Traders said there was an opening bid of 164 tonnes against offer of 111 tonnes. Volume was 131 tonnes versus 129 on Monday.
"The underlying tone is firm and prices are likely to rise to 14 ringgit soon," a trader said, adding that fundamentally, the market remained sound and more foreign buying was expected.
The local price premium over London was $60 a tonne against $50 previously.--Tan Lee Lee (603-275-6834) ($1=2.5170 ringgit)
